notes: The core theme of this book is being different and accepted — 'different' is already in the fixed core row 2 but is so central to the story it is worth retaining as a fringe reinforcer. The word 'different' has been included intentionally as a high-frequency thematic word even though it appears in core. Spookley's square shape saving the other pumpkins in a storm is the climax — 'roll' and 'square' are critical action/descriptor words. If 'different' must be dropped to avoid core duplication, replace with 'save' or 'storm'.
